### [Characteristic Geometry and Portfolio Choice](/research/characteristic-geometry.qmd)

Nearly identical forecasts generate different portfolios because a fixed adjustment to factor variances imposes different exposure penalties across measurement conventions; removing this adjustment nearly eliminates the weight gap.

[Mingyang Liu]{.authors}
